tax.text: Cordell says she will cut taxes and federal spending to help families keep more of their earnings.
tax.quote: I’ll cut taxes, slash federal waste, end job-killing regulations, and defend our small businesses and workers so families can keep more of what they earn.

debt.text: She says she will fight to protect Social Security and Medicare benefits for seniors.
debt.quote: As a rural healthcare expert, Misti will fight to protect Social Security and Medicare benefits for seniors - promises that must be kept.

schools.text: Cordell says she will fight for school choice and return education to local communities.
schools.quote: Parents, not Washington bureaucrats, should control what our children learn. I’ll fight for school choice, oppose woke indoctrination, and return education to local communities where it belongs.

safety.text: She says she will back law enforcement and restore law and order.
safety.quote: Every Louisiana family deserves safe streets. I’ll back our law enforcement, protect your Second Amendment rights, and restore law and order so criminals fear the law again.

immigration.text: Cordell says she will secure the border and stop illegal immigration.
immigration.quote: A nation without borders is not a nation. I’ll secure the border, finish the wall, stop illegal immigration, shut down the cartels, and put Louisiana workers first.

guns.text: She says she will protect Second Amendment rights.
guns.quote: Every Louisiana family deserves safe streets. I’ll back our law enforcement, protect your Second Amendment rights, and restore law and order so criminals fear the law again.

abortion.text: Cordell says she will vote pro-life and believes every child deserves protection.
abortion.quote: Louisiana is built on faith, family, and respect for life. I believe every child deserves protection, girls’ sports should be fair, and parents should guide their families. I'll vote pro-life, defend women’s sports, protect religious freedom, and stand unapologetically for the values that have shaped our communities for generations.

health.text: Cordell supports patient choice and market-based health care solutions.
health.quote: Washington mandates have driven healthcare costs through the roof. I’ll work to expand doctor access, protect patient choice, and fight for affordable market-based solutions that put patients first.

debt.text: He said Medicare benefits seniors have earned should be protected and the program strengthened for future generations.
debt.quote: Our goal should be simple: protect the benefits seniors have earned and make sure Medicare remains strong and sustainable for the long term.

schools.text: He voted for a bill creating Louisiana’s LA GATOR education savings account program for parental choice in K–12 education.
schools.quote: Creates the Louisiana Giving All True Opportunity to Rise (LA GATOR) Scholarship Program to provide educational savings accounts for parental choice in K-12 education.

immigration.text: He called for securing the border, returning people who enter illegally, and deporting immigrants who defraud taxpayers.
immigration.quote: We must secure the border, end the policies that encourage illegal immigration, and ensure that those who enter the country illegally are returned to their home countries.

guns.text: He said he would oppose federal efforts to restrict gun ownership and defend Americans’ right to bear arms.
guns.quote: In Congress, I will oppose any attempt by Washington to erode this fundamental freedom and will stand firmly for the right of Americans to keep and bear arms as the Constitution intended.

abortion.text: He described himself as pro-life and said he would support policies defending unborn life.
abortion.quote: I am proudly pro-life and believe every life is a gift from God that deserves protection.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for Louisiana legislation establishing sex-based eligibility rules for school sports.
gender.quote: YEAS Mr. Speaker Adams Amedee Bacala Beaullieu Bishop Bourriaque Brass Butler Carter, R. Cormier Coussan Crews Davis Deshotel DeVillier DuBuisson Echols

energy.text: He called for expanding domestic energy production and protecting Louisiana’s oil, gas, refining, and energy jobs.
energy.quote: By unleashing American energy, we can lower fuel costs, strengthen our economy, create high-paying jobs, and ensure the United States never again depends on hostile foreign nations for the energy we need.

voting.text: He said he supports nationwide voter ID laws and proof of citizenship to register for federal elections.
voting.quote: I strongly support nationwide voter ID laws to ensure that only eligible citizens vote in American elections. I also support the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which requires proof of U.S. citizenship to register for federal elections

immigration.text: He said he favors a border wall and infrastructure giving complete control over entry and exit.
immigration.quote: I am in favor of construction of a wall and other necessary infrastructure on our border that gives complete control over entering and exiting the United States.

abortion.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he said abortion should not be allowed in any circumstance.
abortion.quote: There is no circumstance under which abortion is necessary or should be allowed.

health.text: He said health care affordability depends on provider competition, consumer choice, and less government regulation.
health.quote: The key to affordable and high quality health care is healthy competition among service providers that provides consumers with increased choices and options, and less governmental interference and regulation.

voting.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he disagreed that people should be able to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification. Strongly Disagree

tax.text: At a candidate forum, he opposed a federal gas tax increase and said there should be no new taxes.
tax.quote: Magee said no new taxes and called for electing "common sense blue collar people."

energy.text: Magee called for repealing the federal 45Q carbon-capture tax credit.
energy.quote: Magee called for repealing 45Q outright. Mebruer said the decision should be left to

tax.text: He called for protecting or restoring SNAP benefits and said food assistance also supports farmers by increasing demand for agricultural products.
tax.quote: “We can afford to feed people in this country,” McKay said, arguing SNAP also benefits farmers by increasing demand for agricultural products.

health.text: His campaign says Medicaid access should be protected and simplified through continuous eligibility and easier renewals.
health.quote: Protecting and simplifying Medicaid access, including continuous eligibility periods and straightforward renewal processes, would stabilize coverage for children, low-income adults, and people with disabilities.
